crossRefs.note: Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to Yahweh, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that…
So Samuel called to Yahweh; and Yahweh sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared Yahweh and…
A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said…
but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come…
Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal…
After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat…
So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to city square which was before the king’s gate.
Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts…
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

translations.web: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
translations.bsb: Like snow in summer and rain at harvest, honor does not befit a fool.
translations.kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
translations.asv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, So honor is not seemly for a fool.
